ns2:section.sectionText: Note: Pre-req for this course will be enforced. Non-Advertising majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program AND that have completed ADV 310 should visit http://illinois.edu/fb/sec/4191600 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only. If you have not completed ADV 310, you will be dropped from the course.
